Comment: Group SDs are not reported; only mean change with 95% CI per group. M_diff computed as group_2_mean - group_1_mean (-0.1 - (-1.4) = 1.3) from the two explicitly reported ITT change means in a simple two-arm between-subjects trial; note sign convention: coaching group is group_1 (treatment), so a positive M_diff here reflects greater weight loss in the app group. Report_ID: Body mass (kg) — change from baseline to 16 weeks
Title: A Contactless App-Based Intervention to Improve Health Behaviors in Airline Pilots: A Randomized Trial
Author: Wilson D, Driller MW, Johnston B, Gill ND
Comment: Change-from-baseline values and 95% CIs are printed in Table 2 as positive magnitudes (e.g., "-2.2 (1.9-2.5)"); signs of the CI bounds were aligned to the reported negative change direction (weight loss). SDs of the change scores are not reported (only baseline and follow-up SDs: intervention 86.4±14.1 -> 84.2±13.7; control 87.5±13.1 -> 87.3±13.3), so no change-score SD is recorded. The p-value <0.001 recorded here is the time X group ANOVA interaction p from Table 2 (recorded as 0.001); the paper explicitly states there was NO significant between-group difference for body mass. The reported between-group Cohen's d is -0.23, where negative indicates lower body mass / greater loss in the app intervention group (i.e., FAVOURING the intervention); sign must be flipped to match the review's positive-direction convention. M_diff not computed because values derive from a covariate-adjusted mixed-design repeated-measures ANOVA rather than a simple two-group comparison. Population is airline pilots with mean BMI ~27.9 (overweight), not a strictly overweight/obesity-selected sample. 16 weeks ≈ 3.7 months, within the short-term window.; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('Intervention group (16-week app-based PA, healthy eating and sleep hygiene intervention via TeamBuildr smartphone app)') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False); treatment SD derived from its reported mean CI; control SD derived from its reported mean CI
